Daz the Decorator

Cheekiest decorator on site, whitest boots in Britain. Stand him in your room and wind him up.

In the headset

Checking for a headset…

On this screen

Click his boots, his jacket or his head. He has something to say about all three.

Things to try in the headset

  • Point at his boots and pull the trigger. Then his jacket. Then his head.
  • Look down at your own feet. He'll compare.
  • Crouch down for a closer look at the toecaps.
  • Walk right up to him, or walk off mid-sentence.
  • Sneak round behind him.
  • Poke him with a controller. Mind the wet paint.
  • Put both hands up over your head.
  • Point at the floor and he'll walk over there.

Headset buttons

  • A or XHe asks you something, then A means yes
  • B or YWind him up, or no when he's asked
  • GripSquat-off: he counts your squats
  • Click a stickPut a tune on
  • Menu buttonLeave

What Daz is saying

  • Nothing yet. He's on his way.
